msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Reproduce the EXACT product from the reference image: identical shape, proportions, materials, colours, stones and details; do not redesign it. Leave out any hands, price tags, stickers, shop text and the original background. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 16:9, referencia fernandez-cruz-miguel-13.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Boutique campaign still life of gilded and silver-plated filigree flamenca hair combs on red damask from the reference. The product sits in the right third of the frame and the scene continues to the left, softly out of focus and calm, with room for a headline. Warm natural light, soft textures. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen or collage. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia fernandez-cruz-miguel-13.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo of a gilded filigree hair comb from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#F1ECE5) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail. IMAGEN 3 «p2» (formato 3:4, referencia fernandez-cruz-miguel-25.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo of a silver rosary with crystal beads and a crucifix from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#F1ECE5) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, referencia fernandez-cruz-miguel-31.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo of a red and green hand-painted wooden flamenco fan from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#F1ECE5) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia fernandez-cruz-miguel-23.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo of an embroidered heraldic shield patch from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#F1ECE5) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail.
